_doc: Reward + curriculum spec the agent edits, then hands to rl/train.mjs. Mirrors the reward dict in headless/env_server.ts; the trainer passes `rewards` into env.reset(). Curriculum stages run in order until each `untilLevel` is reached.
_note_class: headless env supports warrior|mage today; hunter (ryzehunts) needs obs/action wiring in src/sim/obs.ts before a LEARNED hunter executor — see README open questions.
